acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for the outbound trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased.

The system displays the promo code discount amount for both outbound and return trips in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased, and the discount amounts are shown in the same format and location for both trip directions.

The system displays a promo code discount amount of zero for the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when the applied promo code results in a zero-value discount for the return portion, without omitting the promo code line item.

The system correctly renders the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when the order payload contains multiple line items with reversed from/to station codes indicating a return direction.

The system does not display a promo code discount amount for the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when no promo code is applied to the order, and no empty or placeholder promo code line item is rendered for either trip direction.

acceptanceCriteria: When a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased, the Mozio dispatch report.price.discount for the return dispatch element contains the correct discount amount (not zero or omitted), as mapped by mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch in src/clients/mozio/mappers/map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts.

When a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased, getTicketPricePerUnit in src/services/order-staff-notes/generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts returns the correct discount per unit for the return trip (isReturnTrip=true), and the resulting discount value matches the promo code amount allocated to the return portion.

When the order payload contains multiple line items with reversed from/to station codes indicating a return direction, the discount is correctly calculated and included in the Mozio dispatch data for both the outbound and return dispatch elements, with both showing the discount in the same format and location.

When a promo code results in a zero-value discount for the return portion, the discount field in the Mozio dispatch report.price is still present (not omitted) with amount.value of 0, so the promo code line item is rendered in the email confirmation rather than being absent.

When no promo code is applied to the order, no discount field is included in the Mozio dispatch report.price for either outbound or return dispatch elements, and no empty or placeholder promo code line item appears in the Mozio email confirmation.

Unit tests cover the discount mapping for return trips in mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch and the discount calculation in getTicketPricePerUnit with isReturnTrip=true, including cases: promo applied to both directions, promo applied to outbound only, zero-value return discount, and no promo applied.
after.description: The promo code discount amount is not displayed correctly for return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The discount data flows from the order/reservation mapping layer through mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch into the Mozio dispatch payload that Mozio uses to generate confirmation emails. The return-trip discount is either miscalculated (in getTicketPricePerUnit when isReturnTrip=true) or not properly propagated into the dispatch report.price.discount for the return dispatch element.

notes: The promo code discount amount for return trip tickets is not correctly surfaced in the Mozio email confirmation. The code path flows through reservation creation (where return trips have from/to stations swapped and line items are mapped to Mozio format), through to the sanitized Mozio dispatch mapper (which passes discount data to Mozio for their confirmation email), and through the staff-notes mapper (which calculates per-unit discount using getTicketPricePerUnit with isReturnTrip). The bug is most likely in how the discount is calculated or mapped for return-trip line items — either getTicketPricePerUnit returns an incorrect discount for return trips, or the discount is not propagated into the Mozio dispatch report.price.discount for the return dispatch element.

notes: Modified AC1 to remove the file path reference (src/clients/mozio/mappers/...) which violated the what-not-how rule — the observable outcome is the dispatch output, not which file produces it. Modified AC2 to remove the function name getTicketPricePerUnit and file path — reworded as an observable outcome in the order staff notes rather than referencing an internal function's return value. Modified AC3 to clarify 'same format and location' into a concrete structural requirement (amount.value and amount.currency). Modified AC6 to convert from a 'unit tests cover' instruction into a Given/When/Then behavioral statement, removing references to specific function names. Added AC7 (partial promo — outbound-only discount) as a standalone behavioral criterion since openspec's AC6 listed it only as a test case, not as an observable outcome. Added AC8 (currency consistency between discount and base price) — a data integrity edge case not covered by openspec. Added AC9 (data type and validity of discount amount) — prevents silent type coercion bugs where amount.value could be a string or amount.currency could be invalid.
